tracks.title: Do You Want To Know A Secret

physical: Pressed by The Gramophone Co. Ltd.

notes.text:
4th pressing, summer 1963 – January 1964. 
Ernest J. Day front laminated flipback cover with large 'mono' on front. 
Black labels with yellow logo and silver print. 
“The Parlophone Co. Ltd” printed at the start of perimeter print and “Recording first published 1963”, but NOT “Sold in the UK ... ”. 
Tracing-paper-lined “Use Emitex” die-cut inner sleeve. With or without KT tax code embossed on the label center. There also exists a variant with T tax code (on side B).

Aldon Music appears as Aldon Mus. on label.
Ambassador Music Ltd. appears as Ambassador Mus. Ltd. on label.

A similar variant printed by Garrod & Lofthouse Ltd. is:

Publishing:
A1, A2, B4, B6: Northern Songs Ltd.
A3: Shapiro Bernstein & Co. Ltd.
A4: Aldon Mus. Charles Bens. BIEM. NCB. Mecolico.
A5, B1, B2: Ardmore & Beechwood Ltd.
A6, A7: Dick James Mus. Co.
B3: Ludix Mus. BIEM. Mecolico. NCB
B5: Ambassador Mus. Ltd.
B7: Sherwin Mus. BIEM. NCB. Mecolico.

Andy White (uncredited) played drums on 'Love Me Do'.

All matrices in the runout area are stamped. Matrix# on labels are in parentheses.
